svg.title: Outdoor steps
svg.desc: The original six steps, each 0.12 metre rise and 0.42 metre tread, at equal metric scales; source minimum width 1.2 metres. Source claims: steps. The 1.2 m landing length, cut continuation and 1.75 m person are illustration assumptions; the source resting-landing recommendation remains every 10–15 steps. Ground relief is decorative. The edge cue is a graphic line, not a dimensioned contrast strip or complete stair design.
